rust.name: ray
rust.setup_excluded: Decode all four input datums; process startup/compile/instantiate. Parent uses fresh cwd with outputs directory and initially absent destination; no scene preconstruction.
rust.predicate_boundary: Exact retained false/ok result kind/value equality precedes stopped clock. All scene reconstruction, raster/sphere/Euclidean/shading work, formatting, delete/create/write/flush/file close and owned-scene cleanup are timed. Result/CSV printing and complete image hash validation follow stopped clock.
rust.timed: 50 complete100x100 renders; original33-sphere scenes/traversal and every output pixel. No image validation or tracing added to timed kernel.

correctness.predicate: Exact symbol ok for positive repetitions; false for nonpositive counts. String spellings do not satisfy result-kind equality within documented reader domain.
correctness.complete_image_validation: After stopped clock, compare all bytes/header/dimensions/all10000 pixel values; exact byte hash required.

rust.representation: Contiguous fresh Vec<Sphere> with inline F64 points and Option root/hit temporaries, vs original vectors/world cons cells and strict products/options/Hit wrappers/Ref world. All33 spheres remain; no physical allocation parity.
rust.ownership: Owned scene drops inside each invocation; original global world survives until next reset and final world survives after timing. Buffered File flush/drop closes each invocation; close errors are not propagated by drop.
rust.control_semantics: Full original reverse construction order; all sphere visits; smaller including negative roots; Euclidean distance and strict< ties; center-minus-hit normal and ties-even rounding. Original finite scene arithmetic source unchanged.
rust.opacity: Existing black_box filename/resolution each invocation only; every pixel consumed by file IO. Compiler hoists ray-invariant a/4a/2a within a pixel; no artificial barriers or per-pixel audit added.
rust.domain_limits: False is represented by canonical token #f in shared Datum. General alternate boolean/numeric spellings and escaped symbols that coincide with boolean spellings are outside this reader snapshot equivalence; no reader rewrite is included. Counts fit i64; nonnegative resolution/extents/storage fit Wasm32; finite fixed scene. IO error diagnostics/close-error reporting and arbitrary Scheme numeric domains are not claimed.
